hero.title: Echo of the Citizen
hero.subTitle: Your voice is heard clearly
hero.content: a digital platform for submitting and tracking complaints transparently and easily.

submit.title: Easily submit complaints via the app
submit.content: A simple and easy-to-use interface enables citizens to quickly enter details of their complaint and attach photos and documents without complication.

notifications.title: Monitor the status with instant notifications
notifications.content: The citizen receives direct notifications when the complaint status changes, ensuring transparent and accurate follow-up on every step of the process.

secure.title: Security and transparency in data management
secure.content: The system relies on advanced verification and protection mechanisms to ensure the confidentiality of information, with a clear timeline for each modification to enhance trust.

accessible.title: Access from anywhere
accessible.content: Citizens and government agencies can use the platform via a mobile application or web-based control panel, ensuring easy access at any time and from any device.

howWeWorks.title: how the app Echo of the Citizen app
howWeWorks.description: here is a detailed timeline of how Echo of the Citizen works

1.title: Register your account easily
1.content: The user enters basic information and receives a verification code (OTP) by SMS or email. After confirming the code, the account activates instantly — preventing fake accounts and protecting citizens’ data.

2.title: Submit your complaint in simple steps
2.content: The user fills a clear form with: the concerned government authority, complaint type, description of the issue location, photos or documents. When submitted, the system generates a reference number for tracking.

3.title: Track the Complaint Status
3.content: Inside the app, users can see the status of the complaint, Every update triggers an instant notification, so the citizen stays informed at every step.

4.title: Government Agency Processes the Complaint
4.content: Employees see the complaint on their dashboard: review details, request more information,  change status, add notes, upload responses. The system prevents two employees from modifying the same complaint simultaneously, ensuring accuracy and transparency.

5.title: Citizen Receives Updates Instantly
5.content: Whenever the agency changes the status or adds a note, the citizen receives: mobile push notification and in-app alert. This ensures full transparency without needing to visit offices or make calls.
